current_difficulty_reason: The geometric flushing condition does not itself control the small-viscosity observability time. The author constructs a smooth family with a fixed positive bottom energy, combines the weighted eigenfunction/quasimode estimates with its observation geometry, and proves a uniformly bounded exit time for the corresponding trajectories. The same family then has a growing observation lower bound, so the separation requires both the spectral construction and the explicit dynamical argument.
